import { ViewTransition } from 'react'

const directionalAnimations = {
  'nav-forward': 'nav-forward',
  'nav-back': 'nav-back',
  default: 'none',
}

export function PageTransition({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <ViewTransition
      enter={directionalAnimations}
      exit={directionalAnimations}
      default="none"
    >
      {children}
    </ViewTransition>
  )
}

item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. Matching `ViewTransition` names connect each [grid thumbnail](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx) to its [detail hero](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx) for a shared image morph. Typed Next.js links select forward and return slides through the [page wrapper](/workspace/app/PageTransition.tsx), while Suspense skeletons fade into content. The [CSS](/workspace/app/globals.css) disables all transition and skeleton animations when the user prefers reduced motion.

Updated React and React DOM to 19.3.1, which provides the required APIs. The build, TypeScript check, and rendered route markup passed. Browser history Back and Forward do not animate under Next.js; the in-app “Back to products” link does.
